summary: Drains all 4 collision sub-lists (16-byte {head, tail, anchor, count} metadata records starting at this+0x70): for each sub-list, while the head is non-null, removes a node matched by its +0 value, frees the node's payload when the node+8 flag byte is set, frees the node, then allocates a replacement and pushes it onto the global free pool (head dword_8AB700, tail dword_8AB704, count dword_8AB70C, with dword_8AB708 used when the pool is empty). Stores the global session timestamp dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x6C, zeroes the per-sub-list metadata arrays (this+0x35/+0x39/+0x3D dwords and this+0x41 byte, together with a parallel per-sub-list metadata array), sets the enable flag this+0x0 to 1, and returns the pointer past the reset arrays.

local_names.this: physics object list container; 4 sub-list {head, tail, anchor, count} records at this+0x70, stride 16
local_names.v2: pointer to current sub-list metadata record
local_names.v5: head node's +0 value used to locate the node being drained
local_names.result: pointer into the reset metadata arrays (this+53 base)

operations.description: Store the global session timestamp dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x6C.

For each of the 4 sub-lists (head slot this+0x70, tail slot this+0x74, anchor slot this+0x78, count slot this+0x7C), while the head is non-null (guard:0): locate the node whose +0 value equals the head value, unlink it and fix the head/tail/anchor slots and the count, free the node payload via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the node+8 flag byte is set, then free the node itself.
Allocate a replacement node: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success ShortComputation_ac20(headValue, 0), otherwise null.

Push the new node onto the global free pool: if the pool head dword_8AB700 is non-null, link the new node's +4 to it; otherwise initialize the pool head/tail dword_8AB704/dword_8AB708; then set dword_8AB700 = new node and ++dword_8AB70C.
Reset loop, 4 iterations: zero the per-sub-list metadata - the dword entries at this+0x35, this+0x39 and this+0x3D and the byte at this+0x41 - together with a parallel per-sub-list metadata array.
Return the pointer past the reset metadata arrays.
